stages.name: DISPOSABLE_WORKER_SCHEMA
stages.gate: candidate worker SQL installed only after outbox candidate on disposable current schemas

stages.name: LEASE_COLLISION_AND_PROCESS_CRASH
stages.gate: live contender refused; crash leaves durable lease; expiry takeover succeeds; stale generation fenced

stages.name: BACKPRESSURE_AND_BOUNDED_DRAIN
stages.gate: HARD backlog measured; batches respect max; pressure transitions HARD->SOFT->NONE; graph stays closed until exact

stages.name: LONGER_SHADOW_LOAD
stages.gate: sustained event rate, retry/lock/resource/age telemetry within accepted operating window

stages.name: PRODUCTION_SCHEMA_PROMOTION_CANDIDATE
stages.gate: only then consider adding outbox+worker candidate SQL to current migration lists with reversible migration receipt

stages.name: SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT_CANDIDATE
stages.gate: systemd/service entry crosses trusted V4 runtime first, one active worker identity, restart/recovery receipts

rollback.current: delete candidate branch/PR; production schemas and canonical state unchanged
rollback.post_schema_promotion: stop projector, rebuild derived graph from authoritative history, reverse candidate tables if safe
rollback.canonical: only provenance-bound admitted last-known-good under independent RecoveryFloor
